wip_limit: 1. Only one feature may be in_progress. Starting another means parking the current one in blocked with a status_note. The check prints the parked list on every ./init.sh, pass or fail.
rules_enforced_by: scripts/check-feature-list.py — run by ./init.sh before installing anything; aborts if any rule is violated. Reading this file is not checking it.

field_contract.user_visible_behavior: What the user sees once the feature exists. Declares the scope that is IN.
field_contract.scope_out: What is explicitly OUT of this feature. Required in not_started and in_progress. NOT required once parked in blocked — you re-scope it when you wake it up. Without it, the 'Scope discipline' row of evaluator-rubric.md has nothing to check against.
field_contract.status_note: Required in blocked: why it is parked and WHAT unparks it — concrete and actionable.
field_contract.deferred_to: Where the excluded work lives: other feature ids or issues (#N). Must point at something real.
field_contract.verification: Commands/steps to run. Declared BEFORE the work starts.
field_contract.evidence: Actual output of having run `verification`. Empty until it runs. A merged PR does NOT count.

status_legend.in_progress: The single active task. WIP limit is 1 — starting another means parking this one first.
status_legend.blocked: Parked: NOT done and NOT being worked. Covers both an external blocker and work parked to respect the WIP limit — including work that landed but whose executable verification was never captured (a merged PR is not evidence). Requires status_note saying what unparks it.
status_legend.passing: Required verification has passed and evidence is recorded.

features.title: Create a new conversation
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can click New Chat and see a fresh empty conversation.
scope_out: Sending a message into the new conversation — that is chat-002
Surviving a restart — that is chat-003
verification: Verify a new conversation appears in the sidebar.
Verify the main panel shows an empty conversation state.

features.title: Send a message in the current conversation
features.user_visible_behavior: A user can submit a message and see it appear in the active thread.
scope_out: Any assistant/model reply — this feature only echoes the user's own message into the thread
Persisting the message across a restart — that is chat-003
Editing or deleting a sent message
verification: Type a message into the input.
Verify the new message appears in the thread.

features.title: Persist the active conversation list
features.user_visible_behavior: A user sees previously created conversations after restarting the app.
scope_out: Persisting the messages inside each conversation — only the conversation list is in scope here
Migrating conversations created before this feature landed
verification: Verify both conversations still appear in the sidebar.
